facts.fact: Adwave recommends a total monthly budget of roughly $2,000-$3,500 for a newer home builder or remodeler firm under 3 years old.
facts.quote: Roughly $2,000-$3,500/month. Weight toward demand capture and proof

facts.fact: For a newer firm, Adwave's suggested allocation puts 40% of budget into Google Ads.
facts.quote: 40% Google Ads, 25% Meta/Instagram, 20% CTV, 15% photography and portfolio platforms.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends a total monthly budget of roughly $3,500-$6,000 for an established firm with 3-10 years of operation and steady referrals.
facts.quote: Roughly $3,500-$6,000/month. This is where CTV earns a bigger slice

facts.fact: For an established firm, Adwave's suggested allocation puts 30% of budget into CTV and 30% into Google Ads.
facts.quote: 30% Google Ads, 30% CTV, 20% Meta/Instagram, 20% portfolio platforms and photography.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends a total monthly budget of roughly $5,000-$10,000 for a premium or custom builder.
facts.quote: Roughly $5,000-$10,000/month with a brand-led mix

facts.fact: For a premium or custom builder, Adwave's suggested allocation puts 35% of budget into CTV.
facts.quote: 35% CTV, 25% portfolio platforms and premium photography/video, 20% Google Ads

facts.fact: Adwave states that premium custom-builder projects average $300K+.
facts.quote: At $300K+ average projects, a single incremental signed contract funds years of this budget.
